summary: B06 Home Document Vault & Asset Knowledge Capture — first formal test. Backend: 17/18 pytest assertions passed, 1 skipped (confirm/reject exercised only when vision produced fields; a tiny PNG returned 0 fields as expected, so skip is intentional). Every endpoint exercised: upload (image + non-image + missing-file 400), list with counts + review_count + needs_review/is_linked flags, category filter, detail (extractions + relationships + 404), edit (title/category/notes), link-to-asset (mirrors into hi_asset_documents when doc has extracted_text, sets shortcut asset_id, resolves rel.name), invalid link type rejected, review-queue, search (title + category-word collapse), ask (200 + 400 empty), delete cascades extractions/relationships → subsequent GET 404. Frontend (mobile 390x844, demo_home@diyhomie.com): logged in via /auth?mode=login, /home-intel dashboard renders hi-vault; Vault Home shows vault-add, vault-search-btn, all vault-cat-* (with counts), 'Fridge Warranty' visible under Recent uploads with is_linked; Add screen renders add-file, all add-cat-* chips, add-title, add-upload; Search screen renders search-input/search-go; Review page renders empty state ('All caught up'); Detail page for Fridge Warranty shows Ask Homie (returned a properly grounded 'not in the document' answer for a brand question) and Link to Asset modal (doc-linkto-* populated with Water Heater), Delete button present, 'Linked to → Water Heater · Warranty For' relationship name resolves correctly. No red-screen errors. Only console noise = deprecated 'shadow*' style props + Image resizeMode warnings from other screens (unrelated to B06).

minor.issue: Category-word collapse is aggressive: any query that contains a category word (e.g. a title with 'receipt' or 'manual') is silently rewritten to a pure category filter, ignoring the original title text. A user searching for a title like 'Fridge Warranty' will only get category=warranty results. This is per spec but worth surfacing as UX-borderline; if a document was later re-categorised it will not appear in searches for its old title. No fix required.

issues: Console warns 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow.' and 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated' — appear from shared components (not B06-specific). No functional impact on B06 but should be migrated eventually.

action_items: Consider softening the search category-word collapse: fall through to title/text/extraction regex if the pure-category query returns 0 results (currently it returns [] even when the title matches).
Address console deprecation warnings ('shadow*', Image resizeMode) at a global styling pass — not blocking B06.
critical_code_review_comments: document_vault_engine.py: file is ~350 lines, focused, uses async correctly, excludes _id, uses env-driven llm_key, validates categories/rel types/status server-side. Good.

GET /hi/documents/{id} always returns file_base64 by default (include_file=True). The FE list endpoint already strips it, but for very large PDFs / base64 blobs the detail response can be heavy. Consider lazy-loading the file via a separate /file endpoint. Non-blocking.

Link mirroring into hi_asset_documents only fires when doc has extracted_text — that's correct so we don't pollute B01 guidance with empty payloads, but the mirror is one-shot: a later confirm/edit of extractions is not re-synced. Non-blocking, worth documenting.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of testable flows (all testIDs present, navigation + modals + ask + link end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: One fresh TEST_b06_* user created and self-cleaned per test module. Demo user demo_home@diyhomie.com already had a 'Fridge Warranty' document linked to a 'Water Heater' asset from earlier iterations — used it for detail-view verification (not created or altered).
context_for_next_testing_agent: B06 endpoints all live under /api/hi/documents (upload/list/detail/edit/delete/link/extractions/review-queue/search/ask). Extraction review path only meaningfully runs when the uploaded image yields fields; tiny placeholder PNGs return zero fields, so any confirm/reject test should either upload a real document image or seed hi_document_extractions directly. Search endpoint rewrites the query to a category filter if any category word appears in q (see minor issue above). Frontend routes at /home-intel/documents (index, add, [id], search, review). Auth screen route is /auth?mode=login (default mode is register).
rca_of_issue: No functional bug found. The one intentional test-suite skip is documented: gpt-4o vision needs a real document image to produce extractions; a 1x1 PNG legitimately yields zero fields, so the confirm/reject transition was skipped rather than falsely passed. Delete cascade, link-mirroring, search category collapse, ask grounding — all verified working as designed.
